title: •Superficial Damage
caption: •Superficial Damage (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. You may forfeit non-lightsaber weapons (using forfeit value = 3); place your just forfeited weapon in Used Pile. During your deploy phase, if you just deployed a vehicle or starship, may ▼ a weapon (for free) on that vehicle or starship. {alter}
lore: Veteran Rebel engineers know that weapon systems positioned for adequate coverage are vulnerable themselves.

notes: Unique (•). Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. ▼ where the stub expands the phrase; red circle-slash A → {alter}. Slip text matches the stub. Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px; ring = DS2 striped sphere; copyright per DS2 convention. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 354 px).
